invite.title: Accept the invitation
invite.hint: Choose your password and you are in. At least 12 characters.
invite.alreadyAccepted: I already accepted, I want to sign in
invite.usedBody: The link in the email works only once. Sign in with the email and the password you chose.

brand.title: VanaDash, by Vanadium Systems
brand.subline: Finance, clients and email in one place.

password.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

login.title: Sign in
login.forgotShort: I no longer know my password
login.passwordChanged: The password is changed. Sign in with the new one.

forgot.sent: If there is an account for this address, we sent you a link. Keep it open to choose the new password.
forgot.linkValidity: The link is valid for one hour and can be used only once.
forgot.hint: Enter the email you sign in to VanaDash with.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.chatHint: How many we tell you about, in Messages.
notifications.noMailboxes: You have no mailboxes assigned yet.
notifications.alertsHint: When a rule you follow is triggered.

profile.passwordChanged: The password is changed. The other devices were signed out.
profile.displayNameHint: How the rest of the team sees you.
profile.emailHint: The email is changed by the company admin.
profile.newPasswordHint: At least 12 characters. We sign you out of the other devices.

display.title: Display
display.languageHint: The language of the interface and of the messages the app sends you.
display.currencyHint: Totals and charts are shown in this currency, converted at the BNR rate. Each document keeps its own currency.
display.motionHint: How the interface moves: System follows your phone or computer setting, Reduced keeps only fades, Off removes every animation.
display.hideAmountsHint: Amounts show as dots everywhere in the app.
display.sound: Sound when a payment comes in
display.soundHint: A short sound on Home when a new payment appears.

reset.title: Choose the new password
reset.hint: At least 12 characters. No composition rules.
reset.expiredBody: The link is valid for one hour and can be used only once. Request another, then try again.

apiTokens.title: API tokens
apiTokens.intro: For terminal access (vd, Claude Code). A token has at most the permissions of your role.
apiTokens.emptyHint: Create one to sign in from the terminal or Claude Code.
apiTokens.tableCaption: Your API tokens, with last use and expiry

create.title: New token
create.name: Name
create.nameHint: So you recognise it later, for example "laptop".
create.featuresHint: Read-only by default: the pages you can see are ticked. Tick more only for what the script or Claude has to write.
create.notInRole: Your role no longer has one of the chosen features. Reload the page and pick again.
create.copyFailed: The token was not copied. Select it and copy it by hand.

created.title: Your token
created.warning: You will not be able to see it again after you close this.

revokeDialog.title: Revoke token "{{name}}"?
revokeDialog.body: Any script or Claude using it loses access immediately. This cannot be undone.

admin.title: Active API tokens
admin.description: The company's active tokens. Revoke one if a person leaves or a token ended up where it should not be.
admin.tableCaption: The team's active API tokens, with person, last use and expiry

confirmPassword.title: Confirm your password
confirmPassword.body: This action needs your password once more.

devices.title: Devices
devices.intro: Where you are logged in. You stay logged in as long as you open the app at least once every 60 days.
devices.tableCaption: The devices you are logged in on, with last activity and login date

logoutDialog.title: Log out “{{device}}”?
logoutDialog.body: On that device you will have to log in again with your password.

logoutOthersDialog.title: Log out the other devices?
logoutOthersDialog.body: On all of them you will have to log in again with your password. This device stays logged in.

devices.failed: Could not log the device out.
